limitations: No human listener reviewed these recordings. This is a production-ASR intelligibility proxy, not an independent quality score.
Recognition cannot distinguish ASR spelling mistakes from TTS pronunciation errors or rule out unrecognized content.
The fragment is actual short speech and was declared exploratory; this review does not classify its finalized user text as non-speech hallucination.
Word content supports incomplete original result speech in fragment cases, but does not identify exact stop/resume times, physical playback, or the cause of interruption.
All captured samples and silence were retained. Concatenation inserts no callback-arrival gaps; use transport logs for timing.
Twelve dependent synthetic development trials with repeated assets; no statistical generalization, human microphone or echo evidence.
The initial effect may already be complete while its spoken ETA is interrupted. Tool-effect correctness and spoken completion are separate outcomes.
All12 capture rows remain in the denominator. No transcript-based exclusions, clipping or retries were performed.
The timed-suite worker required SIGKILL after its20s graceful-shutdown deadline; this separate ASR subprocess completed normally after all three stack services had stopped.
